brief.title: Frostbound
brief.tagline: Relearn the runes. Wake the dragon within.
brief.artStyle: cinematic oil-painting realism, visible painterly brushwork, soft atmospheric haze, low golden-hour backlight against cold blue shadows, weathered textures, strong silhouettes, palette of steel blue, glacial white, charcoal slate and ember gold
brief.fontVibe: carved weathered stone serif capitals, chiseled edges, frost clinging to the grooves, faint ember-gold glow seeping from cracks in the letters
brief.logoPrompt: The title "Frostbound" as a game logo, centered, in carved weathered stone serif capital lettering with chiseled edges, frost and ice crystals in the grooves, faint ember-gold light glowing from hairline cracks, steel blue and rime white tones, subtle bevel and depth, isolated on a flat solid plain white background, no scene, no other text
brief.emblemPrompt: A bold flat vector emblem: a angular rune-carved circle in steel blue with a stylized dragon claw or flame-shaped rune in ember gold at its center, a small snowflake-like fracture motif around the edge, simple geometric shapes, strong silhouette, deep slate background, centered, iconic, no text or letters
brief.keyArtPrompt: Cinematic wide shot in oil-painting realism: a lone cloaked exile with a faintly glowing ember-gold rune on one raised hand stands on a snowy ridge before crumbling ancient stone ruins and standing runestones, vast frozen northern mountains stretching away, a colossal dragon silhouetted on the distant horizon with golden low sun breaking through clouds, drifting snow and cold steel blue shadows, calm open sky and soft haze in the center-upper area as negative space, painterly brushwork, no text, no letters, no logos
brief.stingPrompt: Five seconds: slow cinematic push-in on the key art as snow drifts across the frame in layered parallax, a warm ember-gold light sweep rolls across the mountains and ruins, the distant dragon's wings shift subtly, the carved stone logo catches a glint and its cracks pulse with golden glow. Sound: deep low wind swell, a distant dragon roar echoing, a resonant stone-on-ice impact as the logo settles, shimmering crystalline chimes fading out.
brief.trailerPrompt: 1) Slow aerial glide over frozen northern mountains and snow-buried ruins at dawn, wind-blown snow, a dragon silhouette crossing the pale sun; low droning strings and howling wind. 2) Tracking shot of the cloaked dragon-blooded exile trudging through a blizzard, then kneeling to touch a runestone that ignites with ember-gold light; a single cello note builds. 3) Dynamic wide-to-close action: the exile unleashes rune magic, carving glowing sigils in the air to shatter ice golems and freeze a charging beast mid-leap, then leaps off a cliff as the dragon rises behind; drums and brass surge with cracking ice impacts. 4) Calm slow push-in as the exile stands on a ridge facing the dragon, eyes flickering gold, the screen fading to the carved stone Frostbound logo with a final booming hit and fading wind.
brief.trailerLine: What the cold buried, the blood remembers.

brief.storeBlurb: Cast out and carrying dragon blood, you wander the frozen northern kingdoms in search of forgotten rune magic. Explore a vast open world of ancient ruins, brutal storms and towering beasts as you master the power that exiled you.
features: Explore a vast, frozen open world of ruined kingdoms
Relearn lost rune magic and craft your own spells
Unleash dragon-blooded powers in fluid, weighty combat
Forge your fate through choices that reshape the north
